title: XSS: render_photo_grid unescaped URLs
description: In fieldwork/src/util.rs:render_photo_grid(), post_url and file_url are interpolated directly into HTML href and src attributes without escaping. Only alt text is sanitized via ammonia::clean(). An attacker-controlled URL containing a double quote can break out of the attribute context and inject arbitrary HTML. All three servers (broadside, smallhold, gaja) that render photo grids are affected. Fix: escape file_url and post_url through ammonia or html_escape before interpolation.
